messages:
maria: Quick review: I'm worried the retry affordance in network checks is confusing. The UI shows a small link 'retry' next to each failed probe, and a 'Retry all' button at the top. Keyboard users can't easily discover per-probe retry. Thoughts?

sam: Good call. The per-probe retry should be a visible button not just a link. Use <button> so it appears in tab order and announces role.

olivia: Also a copy/pattern suggestion: change link text to 'Try again' -> clearer action. For screen readers include aria-label like 'Retry egress SSH check'.

maria: For failure state microcopy: current text is 'probe failed: contact infra'. Feels blamey. Propose: 'Egress SSH check failed. Try the suggested fixes or contact infra if the issue persists.'

jeff: +1 softer tone. Add an inline 'Suggested fixes' expander with brief steps. Default collapsed. That helps support reduce tickets.

sam: Accessibility: when a probe fails and user expands 'Suggested fixes', focus should move to the expander content and the expander should have role='region' and aria-labelledby pointing to header. Also update aria-live summary: '1 failed, 3 passed'.

olivia: Important: don't duplicate live announcements. If we announce aggregate summary, suppress per-probe toast announcements. Use a single polite live region at top of step for summary updates.

maria: UX trade: do we enable 'Retry all' while checks streaming? If someone hits 'Retry all' mid-stream, confusing. Maybe disable Retry all until stream completes, and show a tooltip 'Retry available after current run finishes'.

sam: Technical note: SSE stream emits 'run_id' and 'complete' flag. Frontend can map to disable state easily. Use disabled attribute and aria-disabled for screen readers.

jeff: QA ask: add a test that tab order hits per-probe retry buttons, and that aria-live summary announces 'Network checks: 2 failed, 6 passed' once run completes.

olivia: Also color+icon: failed uses red exclamation. Add text label 'failed' next to icon for colorblindness. Keep contrast.

maria: Action items: sam to replace retry links with buttons and hook disabled state to stream complete. olivia to draft aria snippets and copy for suggested fixes. jeff to update figma with explainer accordion. qa-bot add cypress checks for tab order and live-region announcement.

qa-bot: Reminder: include test for 'Retry all' tooltip accessibility (visible on focus).
